senses.sense_definition: A primitive type of lobe-finned fish that was believed to be extinct for millions of years until a living one was found in 1938.

examples.text: Scientists were shocked to discover a living <w>coelacanth</w> in the deep waters off the coast of South Africa.
The <w>coelacanth</w> is often referred to as a living fossil because it has changed very little over millions of years.
